audit.why: K'Sante is a low-damage scaling tank; Aatrox owning levels 1 through first item and losing late matches the 52.89% win rate and the existing stage sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike said All Out "knocks you back and strips his own resistances" but missed the half that matters to you.
audit.why: Riot's text: while All Out, Path Maker "deals increased damage and no longer knocks back or stuns". His only interrupt of your Q chain switches off the moment he ults.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] now states it: once he is All Out, your chain runs clean.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ntofo Strikes was described as a "pull" with no condition, and Path Maker as a "block".
audit.why: Ntofo Strikes pulls only at 2 stacks (3.5s cooldown); Path Maker is a charge-up with damage reduction, then a dashing knockback/stun — it is not a block. All Out also launches you through walls.
audit.corrected: early and mid now state the 2-stack condition, the charge-up damage reduction, and the wall launch.

edits.before: His All Out (R) knocks you back and strips his own resistances for damage — but pre-item he can't kill you through your drain. Trade freely; your R heal amp wins the extended brawl.
edits.after: All Out (R) launches you back through walls and strips his own resistances — but while he is All Out, Path Maker no longer knocks back or stuns, so your Q chain runs clean. Trade freely.

edits.before: Use W (Path Maker) block and knockback to negate your all-in
edits.after: Charge Path Maker (W) to soak your combo, then knock you back

edits.before: Levels 1-2 already tilt your way: K'Sante has a poke-and-sustain pattern with Ntofo Strikes but such low early damage that your base stats win the short exchanges even before your combo is online. Don't force anything into his W (Path Maker), which blocks a hit and knocks back — eating that mid-combo wastes your all-in. Farm, dodge his Q, and wait for level 3.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 already tilt your way: Ntofo Strikes (Q) is a 3.5s poke that only pulls at two stacks, and K'Sante's early damage is so low your base stats win short exchanges before your combo exists. Don't commit into Path Maker (W) — he takes reduced damage while charging it, then dashes out knocking you back. Farm, watch his Q stacks, and wait for level 3.

edits.before: From level 3 through 6 you're the favourite. K'Sante is a scaling tank with weak early damage, so once you have your full kit you out-brawl him: bait his Q pull and W knockback, then E in and chain Q1-Q2-Q3 while W (Infernal Chains) pins him. Your drain plus passive heal out-sustains his trades. At 6 his All Out repositions you and drops his resistances, but pre-item he can't out-damage your R heal amp — commit and grind him down.
edits.after: From level 3 through 6 you're the favourite. K'Sante is a scaling tank with weak early damage, so with your full kit you out-brawl him: let Ntofo Strikes reach two stacks and pull, eat the Path Maker knockback, then E in and chain Q1-Q2-Q3 while W pins him — Footwork (E) is 10s at rank 1 and is all he has left. At 6, All Out repositions you and drops his resistances, but pre-item he cannot out-damage your R heal amp.

notes: spikes[2] reads "After Eclipse/Goredrinker" — the packet flagged "After Eclipse" as a probable wrong ability name. FALSE POSITIVE: those are items, not abilities. Left unchanged.
